pr_title: Deferred: Remove undocumented progress notifications in $.when
pr_body:
Fixes gh-2710

Although we could add a new feature to notify on the new Deferred once each thenable resolved/rejected, it seemed like that would encourage more Deferred-specific behavior and I wasn't sure I wanted to go there. The important 3.0 behavior change here is removing the notification pass-through, which was [undocumented](http://api.jquery.com/jquery.when/). We can always add new functionality in a 3.x.0 if it's requested.
pr_comments:
By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @markelog, @gibson042 and @jaubourg to be potential reviewers
This looks pretty good to me.
LGTM.

issue_context.title: $.when + progress
issue_context.body:
http://jsfiddle.net/timmywil/608mu479/1/

We currently don't have documentation for progress in $.when and there are some funky behaviors. [@dmethvin proposed](https://github.com/jquery/jquery/issues/2018#issuecomment-143330148) we drop "the current progress pass-thru and generate one progress notification for each resolved subordinate promise".

review_comments:
> We currently don't have tests for progress in $.when

So we do have tests?
Yes we did. However, the docs say nothing about it, and it seems strange to pass through the notifications from the subordinates all mixed into the master deferred.
